reason: The only cited evidence (E1) shows DCT improves strength and ductility in a different BCC HEA (HfNbTaTiZr) and induces a phase transition, but it provides no support for the irradiation-tolerance mechanism, residual stress relief, or transferability to NbMoTaW. The key premises about irradiation defect trapping and slip system activation are unsupported by any cited passage.
